features.Terrifying Ambush: At the start of each scene, enemies must pass a DC 14 Discipline test or lose their fast turn unless they spend 2 focus.
features.Ruthless Predator: Deal 1d8 additional damage to enemies who haven't taken a turn yet in the current round.

Strike Crushing Jaw.Saving Throw: Use 2 actions to make a DC 16 Agility or Athletics test, ending the Restrained condition
Strike Crushing Jaw.Description: On hit the target is Restrained, spend 1 focus to also make the target Afflicted [1d4 vital] until the target regains at least 1 health

Tail Sweep.Saving Throw: DC 15 Athletics test or be knocked Prone
Tail Sweep.Description: The khornak can spend up to 2 focus to target that many additional targets with the same attack.

Drag.Description: The khornak moves up to 15 feet in any direction while dragging an enemy they have Restrained behind them.
